tags.qa_notes: Deep re-audit 2026-10-09. Re-fetched scubastlucia.com, blog.padi.com, moorings.com, stolentime.com, stlucia.org. Confirmed drift dive/sloping wall at base of Petit Piton, moderate-strong current. Marine life rewritten to site-attributed species only; southern stingrays/sea turtles (carried forward unsourced) stripped; unsourced '12-21 m red rope sponge/elephant ear sponge' colour claim stripped. Whale sharks/humpbacks only as occasional passing reports (stolentime, moorings). DEPTH 50 m UNCONFIRMED: sources give only a '1500 ft' typo; field left, flagged.

Deep re-audit 2026-10-09. Re-fetched scubastlucia.com (plateau 5-25 ft to 140 ft, morays, parrotfish, blennies, crabs, needlefish; required first dive), moorings.com, stlucia.org (5-18 m shallow reef, trumpetfish, turtles). Removed '150+ fish species' and SMMA '20ft-140ft' claims (not re-confirmed). Added trumpetfish/turtles (stlucia.org).

Re-audit 2026-10-09. Only scubastlucia.com 'Anse Couchon' (boulder slope; seahorses, scorpionfish, cleaner shrimp) and stlucia.org Anse Cochon north/south descriptions match; no source names a 'Pinnacles' site at Anse Cochon and scubastlucia 'Pinnacles' = four seamounts (Key Hole). Pinnacle type and 18 m depth unconfirmed; fewer than 3 sources; validated downgraded to false. smmainc.com/divesaintlucia.com carried-forward claims (hawksbill) removed.

Deep re-audit 2026-10-09. Four seamounts rising to near-surface with black/orange gorgonians confirmed by padi, scubastlucia ('Pinnacles'), moorings, stolentime, stlucia.org. Species now attributed per source. Removed 'mild currents channelling between peaks' and the divein 'voted 10 Best' claim (not re-fetched). Depth 30 m unconfirmed. Whale shark/sunfish: moorings only, not repeated.

Deep re-audit 2026-10-09. Crescent reef, 40 ft plateau to 150 ft+, pillar coral/barrel sponges, hawksbill and green turtles confirmed (scubastlucia, stolentime, stlucia.org). Stripped carried-forward parrotfish, blue chromis, damselfish, moray eels, spiny lobsters (no source). Turtle frequency differs between sources (often vs occasionally).

Wreck deep re-audit 2026-10-09. 165 ft freighter agreed (scubastlucia, padi, islanderkeys, stolentime; stlucia.org also lists 167 ft). Sinking year 1986 (most) vs 1985 (other listings seen in search results) flagged; Oct 1986 only stolentime. Fisheries Dept: caribbean-diving, stolentime. Location conflict: Anse Cochon (padi, islanderkeys, stlucia.org) vs Anse La Raye (stolentime). Depth range 12-22 m (scubastlucia 65 ft max; padi 40-65 ft; islanderkeys 60 ft; caribbean-diving 22 m, max 20-30 m). Build date, original name, tonnage: not found in any source; no Wikipedia/wrecksite entry found. Removed unsourced 'rudder and propeller intact' claim; added penetration-training caution. Marine life attributed per source.

Re-audit 2026-10-09. Only 2 sources (scubastlucia 'Jalousie'; stolentime 'Gros Piton Reef' with identical wording). scubastlucia lists it as a boat dive; shore-entry claim unsupported, entry_type changed shore->boat. Stripped carried-forward seahorses/trumpetfish; added morays/reef crabs/lobsters (stolentime). Depth 15 m unconfirmed. Left validated=true but below 3-source threshold; needs a third source.

Deep re-audit 2026-10-09. Wall 18-34 m (60-110 ft) confirmed by padi and stlucia.org; maxDepth corrected 40->34 m. Stingrays/eagle rays (padi, stlucia.org). Jacks, Bermuda chub, spotted drums and 'best place for turtles' now attributed to stolentime (previously removed as unconfirmed; found in this pass). divein.com/tikaye.com not re-fetched; dropped from sources.

Wreck deep re-audit 2026-10-09. 244 ft Japanese dredger (scubaweather, moorings, stlucia.org); 224 ft reported by a Scuba Diving magazine itinerary (search result) - length conflict flagged. Bought early 1990s to dredge Vieux Fort (scubaweather). Sunk 1996 (moorings, stlucia.org); Sept 1996 + Fisheries Dept (divefairhelen via search summary; page 503 on direct fetch). Orientation conflict: on its side (stlucia.org, divefairhelen) vs inverted (one diver review) - flagged. Hurricane Lenny 1999 claim removed (unsupported). Tonnage omitted (single source). Depth 33 m (stlucia.org), 10-33 m (moorings). Marine life restored per source: barracuda, eels, pufferfish, angelfish, jacks, turtles (moorings only). No Wikipedia/wrecksite entry found. COORDINATES: lat 14.05/-61.01 looks inconsistent with a site near Anse Cochon; not changed (no source).

Deep re-audit 2026-10-09. Base of Gros Piton, sea plume forests/juvenile fish, sargassum triggerfish, barracuda confirmed (scubastlucia, stolentime, stlucia.org). Removed unsupported claims: shore entry/sand beach, 20-min boat ride, drift sections, entry-level training use, 770 m Piton height. entry_type shore->boat (scubastlucia boat listing; Piton sites are 'further away'). Depth 14->27 m and difficulty Beginner->Intermediate per stlucia.org 15-90 ft range.

Re-audit 2026-10-09. No source (scubastlucia, padi, moorings, stolentime, stlucia.org) names a site called 'The Drift (Pitons)'; likely duplicate of Superman's Flight. Marine life stripped (no site-specific sources). validated downgraded to false. Recommend removal review.

Deep re-audit 2026-10-09. Dramatic site, deep-water gorgonians/sea whips, brain corals, barrel sponges (scubastlucia); boulders over sheer wall, occasional large barracuda, few big fish due to fishing (stolentime); terrace to wall, 'The Big House' (stlucia.org). NAME CONFLICT: scubastlucia glosses 'large reef'; stlucia.org 'The Big House'; July correction to 'Great House' (divein.com) could not be re-fetched. Depth 30 m unconfirmed. No species list besides barracuda.

tags.name: El Pirata Shipwreck
tags.qa_notes: Re-audit 2026-10-09. Two further searches (El Pirata + Vieux Fort wreck; wreck directories) again found no source naming this wreck. OSM tags remain the only evidence. Unresolved: zero wreck facts verifiable (name, build, length, tonnage, sinking cause). Stays unvalidated.

tags.name: Fairyland
tags.qa_notes: Deep re-audit 2026-10-09. Plateau 40-60 ft, vivid coral/sponge, drift (scubastlucia); currents (padi); starts at West Point beside Turtle Reef (stolentime); 40-200 ft (stlucia.org). Removed 'Scuba St. Lucia named the site' and SMMA 'most beautiful' claims (not re-confirmed). Octopus breeding ground/lobsters/stingrays/flounder re-attributed to moorings.com (was misattributed). Chromis/creole wrasse now confirmed by stolentime.
